assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D crop sprite atlas for FarmSim iOS SpriteKit and inventory thumbnails. Edit the reference atlas into a NEW atlas of the following eight crops; use the reference only to preserve its warm hand-painted, crisp, richly shaded farming-game style and slightly elevated three-quarter view. Replace its subjects and grid with EXACTLY 4 equal-width columns by 8 equal-height rows, 32 separate sprites total, portrait 1024 x 2048 canvas. All 32 cells must exist. Columns left to right: tiny seedling, young growing plant, mature unripe plant, harvest-ready plant with recognizable produce. Rows top to bottom, in exact order: 1. Carrot with orange roots; 2. Potato with earthy tan tubers; 3. Parsnip with cream tapering roots; 4. Onion with golden round bulbs; 5. Garlic with ivory garlic bulbs; 6. Turnip with purple-topped white bulbs; 7. Ginger with knobbly ginger roots and lance-shaped leaves; 8. Frost Potato with pale icy-blue tubers and cool teal leaves. For each row, all four stages are the SAME crop. Healthy foliage, believable species silhouettes, warm sunlight from upper left, soft painterly highlights, readable at 48 pixels. A rooted planted specimen in every cell, not loose detached produce. Root crops may show their mature bulbs/tubers beside foliage for clear game recognition. Shared bottom-center anchor at 88% of each cell height; mature stage fills at most 78% of cell width and height; seedlings are intentionally smaller but share the anchor. Keep at least 10% transparent clearance to every cell edge. The complete image background must be genuinely transparent alpha, including all spaces between plants. NO scenery, soil tile, ground patch, labels, words, numbers, grid lines, border, shadows extending outside the cell, extra objects, watermark, or poster composition. Produce the whole exact strip grid in ONE coherent pass; no missing, merged, or repeated columns.
